title: Grits with Cheese and Added Fat

content.title: About
content.content: Grits with cheese and added fat is a ready‑to‑eat product consisting of cooked grits mixed with grated cheese and a small amount of vegetable or butter fat. It offers a creamy, cheesy flavor combined with the nutty notes of the grain.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Grits are made from ground corn and have been a staple in Southern cuisine for centuries.
Cheese adds calcium, protein, and a rich umami taste to the dish.
The added fat improves the absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins such as vitamin D and K2 found in cheese.
Corn grits contain antioxidants like lutein that support eye health.
Ready‑to‑eat grits are convenient for quick meals without the need for cooking.

items.title: Good source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Grits provide steady energy and are easier to digest than many whole grains.

items.title: Provides protein and calcium
items.content: Cheese contributes high‑quality animal protein and calcium for bone health.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: The product supplies thiamine, niacin, and folate, which support metabolism.

items.title: Enhanced vitamin absorption
items.content: Added fat helps the body absorb fat‑soluble vitamins present in the cheese.

items.title: Supports heart health
items.content: Corn grits are low in saturated fat, and the modest amount of added fat can be chosen as a heart‑healthy oil.

items.title: Dairy allergy or lactose intolerance
items.content: The cheese component may trigger reactions in people sensitive to milk proteins or lactose.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Added fat increases the calorie count, so portion control is advisable.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Cheese often contains salt; individuals monitoring sodium intake should be aware.

items.title: Potential gluten cross‑contamination
items.content: While grits are naturally gluten‑free, processing facilities may handle gluten‑containing grains.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The product is ready to eat straight from the package. It can be enjoyed as a snack, mixed into salads, used as a filling for sandwiches, or warmed in the microwave for a hot meal.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in the original sealed package or an airtight container. Once opened, consume within 5‑7 days. Discard if you notice off‑flavors or discoloration.
